resources.string: Plays behind the focused app on Home and in the app grids, in the theme colour: random lightning strikes, or Arabic letters and eight-point stars that fade in and out.

1 · Open the assistant
• On Home: the round assistant button at the end of the bottom bar.
• Anywhere: hold the ☰ Menu button for about half a second. In other apps this needs quick actions (Settings › Home & system); without them it works only inside Lumora.
• From here: Open assistant (above).

2 · Type or speak
• Type with the remote, then Send.
• Speak: press the phone button in the panel, scan the QR code with your phone (same Wi-Fi), tap the microphone on the phone keyboard, speak, tap Send. English and Arabic both work.
• The phone link stays open while the panel is open, and closes after 10 idle minutes.

3 · Instant commands (no API key, no internet)
Send the command on its own; a polite word such as "please" or "لو سمحت" is fine.
• Play: play, resume, continue · شغل، كمل، استمر
• Pause: pause, stop, hold on · وقف، ايقاف، استوب
• Next: next, skip, next episode · التالي، الحلقة التالية
• Previous: previous, previous episode · السابق، الحلقة السابقة
• Seek: fast forward, rewind · قدم، ترجيع
• Volume (2 steps): volume up, louder · volume down, quieter · علي الصوت، ارفع الصوت · وطي الصوت، قلل الصوت
• Mute: mute, unmute · اكتم، فك الكتم
• Navigate: back, home · ارجع، الرئيسية
• Screenshot, power menu · لقطة شاشة، قائمة الطاقة
• Settings: settings, wifi settings, bluetooth settings, display settings, sound settings · الاعدادات، اعدادات الواي فاي، اعدادات البلوتوث، اعدادات الشاشة، اعدادات الصوت

4 · Ask in your own words (needs the OpenRouter key and TV control On)
• Open an app: "open YouTube" · "افتح نتفليكس"
• Search inside an app: "search Netflix for Dark" · "ابحث في يوتيوب عن وصفات"
• Volume by steps (1–10): "turn the volume up 5 steps"
• Theme: "switch the theme to rose" (amber, copper, rose, moonlight)
• Settings pages: "open Bluetooth settings", also apps and about
• Several at once: "pause and lower the volume" (up to 4 actions)
• Anything else: "what should I watch tonight?" · "ما عاصمة اليابان؟"
Locked apps still ask for the lock code.

5 · What it cannot do
• Back, Home, Screenshot and Power menu need quick actions.
• When the TV or soundbar controls the volume (HDMI-CEC), use the remote's volume keys.
• Some players ignore fast forward and rewind.
• It cannot read the screen, press other buttons or type inside other apps.
• The Alexa button stays with Alexa; Fire OS does not pass it to apps.

6 · Tips
• Clear starts a new conversation.
• TV control Off: answers only, nothing changes on the TV.
• Free models are limited per minute and per day; instant commands are not affected.
• Answers come from a free model picked at random; if one is weak, ask again.
